dedupe_keys.name: covid 19 variant prevalence in waste water

description: COVID-19 Variant Prevalence in Waste Water is a dataset listed in Ramsey County open data portal (data.ramseycountymn.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Ramsey County. SARS-CoV-2 prevalence in wastewater influent is determined from multiple samples of wastewater each day. Units are in millions of copies of N1 and N2 genes, per person in the sewage treatment area, per day. Viral load data are from Metropolitan Council and the University of Minnesota Genomics Center. Coverage: Ramsey County, Minnesota. The portal files it under the category Public Health. The table has 4 columns. Attribution on the portal: Metropolitan Council. The portal shows 2023-09-26 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ramseycountymn-gov-portal.
